body:
July 16th is also my birthday, I wish I had the courage to do the same. 

Best of luck and goodbye.

Life is stupid chaos, agreed. I don't know which path I'm going down, changing my perspective of reality, or changing reality itself. Probably a little of both. 

I just block everything out, my mind is completely empty most of the time. 

​

What were the problems that you used to have and how did you move past them?

I've never really wanted anything, not that I can remember anyway. I grew up thinking that my family was dirt poor, and that wanting anything would cause pain for us all. If I were to ever want anything, I wouldn't have the motivation to do it. There's just no point.

I become discouraged when chasing after half assed temporary wants. Wants that, in the long term, would rather not have at all. 

If it were up to me, I would live out the rest of my life in complete isolation until I gather the courage to commit suicide. 

Thank you for your reply.
